ops.justification: Universal executor. Dispatches any of the 1145 catalogued Akamai operations in the embedded registry by tool name, so a single MCP tool covers the whole surface rather than one tool per operation.
Local registry query. Discovers operation tool names for akamai_raw_request; served from the embedded registry, no outbound call.
Local registry query. Coverage statistics from the embedded registry, no outbound call.
Bounded convenience composite. Fetches user profile, contracts, and groups in one call.
